Risk Description: An improperly configured S3 bucket could expose sensitive customer records to unauthorized individuals, resulting in a data breach and regulatory consequences.
Recommended Controls: Enable S3 Block Public Access; review bucket policies; enable encryption; monitor configuration changes.

Risk Description: An attacker could compromise an IAM credential with excessive permissions, allowing unauthorized access to production resources and sensitive information.
Recommended Controls: Enforce MFA; apply least privilege; remove unused credentials; monitor suspicious activity with GuardDuty and CloudTrail.

Risk Description: Insufficient CloudTrail logging or monitoring could prevent the organization from detecting suspicious activity and investigating security incidents.
Recommended Controls: Enable organization-wide CloudTrail logging; protect log integrity; centralize logs; configure monitoring and alerts.

Risk Description: Customer information stored without appropriate encryption could be exposed if storage media, backups, or data access are compromised.
Recommended Controls: Enable encryption at rest using AWS KMS; enforce encryption in transit; review key permissions and rotation settings.

Risk Description: Delayed reviews of employee and service-account permissions could allow former employees or unnecessary accounts to retain access to sensitive resources.
Recommended Controls: Conduct quarterly access reviews; promptly remove terminated-user access; document approvals and exceptions.

Risk Description: Infrastructure risk: An overly permissive AWS security group could expose a production server to unauthorized SSH connection attempts from any IPv4 address, potentially resulting in system compromise, customer data exposure, and business disruption.
Recommended Controls: Restrict inbound SSH access to approved IP addresses or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager; review security group rules and monitor access attempts.

Risk Description: Operational risk: Acme Financial Services may be unable to restore its critical customer database within an acceptable timeframe following a disruption because backups have never been tested and documented recovery procedures are absent.
Recommended Controls: Establish approved RTO and RPO targets; perform regular backup restoration tests; document recovery procedures; protect backups against unauthorized deletion.

Risk Description: An attacker could exploit a known critical vulnerability in outdated software on an internet-facing production server, potentially compromising customer information and disrupting the customer portal.
Recommended Controls: Establish critical patching deadlines; perform regular vulnerability scans; verify remediation with follow-up scans; monitor for exploitation; maintain protected and tested backups.
